feature_descriptions.monthly_claim_count: Number of claims submitted in the month
feature_descriptions.log_total_reimbursement: log(1 + total reimbursement) for the month
feature_descriptions.unique_beneficiaries: Distinct beneficiaries served in the month
feature_descriptions.ip_claim_pct: Fraction of claims that are inpatient
feature_descriptions.avg_reimbursement: Average per-claim reimbursement in the month
feature_descriptions.repeat_bene_count: Beneficiaries with more than one claim in the month

values.0.0: Leading padding month (before provider's first observed claim)
values.1.0: Valid observation month (within provider's active window; includes actual zero-claim months)

ordering: Chronological (most recent seq_len months; leading zero-pad if shorter)
